caption: The drawing depicts a woven basket, shown from two perspectives: a top-down view and a side view. The basket is round and shallow, with a wide, slightly concave form. The color palette consists mainly of light tan and reddish-brown tones. The top view reveals intricate patterns made by alternating the two colors. At the center is a spiral pattern in tan, surrounded by a series of reddish-brown geometric motifs arranged in a circular fashion that resemble a star or flower shape. Further out, a band of light tan filled with repeating triangular shapes creates a saw-tooth pattern, also in reddish-brown, encircling the central motif. The rim features a repeating sequence of three rectangular reddish-brown marks spaced evenly apart. The side view shows the shallow depth of the basket and the continuation of the same geometric patterns along the outside walls. The drawing is bordered by a single thin line, and the name "Cordena Jackson" appears near the bottom right of the page.
title: Basket
